pieces.Text: You combine a natural green thumb and knowledge of magic in order to grow magic plants.

You can cultivate magic plants; see Chapter 7 for several example types of magic plants. Cultivating a magic plant takes 1 week per 1,000 gp in its base price. When you create a magic plant, you make the same choices that you would normally make when casting the spell. Whoever consumes the fruit of the magic plant is the target of the spell. See page 247 for full rules for cultivating magic plants.
